versions.content: The Crypto Stack shall support secure storage of crypto- graphic artifacts Status: DRAFT Description: The Crypto Stack shall support secure storage of cryptographic artifacts, including but not limited to the following items: • Secret, Private and Public Keys • Algorithm-specific Domain Parameters • Symmetric or asymmetric Signatures • Password Hashes • Secret Seeds • Certificate Signing Requests • Certificates and Certificate Chains • Certificate Revocation Lists Correspondent protection measures should be applied to each artifact according to its type: confidentiality, integrity, authenticity.
